<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
**Updating text editor options**

I need to create a rich text editor file to update the CMS editing page for the basic template. Currently, some fields defined as "text" could benefit from being rich text, especially for sections like the hero or newsletter blurb. The user's suggestion about making all necessary fields rich text makes sense, so I plan to update page.body for sure. Features items will stay as plain strings, but I might want to adjust certain fields to accommodate rich text formatting.
**Converting text fields to rich text**

I'm planning to convert `TemplateField` types from "text" to rich text editor, but I need to consider how that impacts home content editing. Currently, those fields are plain text and rendered simply in templates. If I start storing HTML, it can complicate rendering, potentially breaking the design. I think it might be better to keep template fields as plain text but allow for limited rich text. For `pages.body`, I'll focus on updating display and preview options while ensuring we can effectively store content as HTML. Existing plain text can be wrapped in `<p>` tags or treated based on HTML context.
**Implementing rich text rendering**

I’m planning to implement helper functions like `renderRichText` or `coerceRichTextHtml`. I want to update the CMS editor to initialize the body as HTML; if it’s plain text, I might convert it into paragraphs. When loading, I’ll set the editor’s value to `body`, ensuring that if it's plain, I escape and wrap it in `<p>` tags. I'll create a function that checks if the string looks like HTML and update our schema accordingly, but it seems the user didn’t mention migration, so I’ll keep `body` as a string. The editor will be in one file and include toolbar buttons for editing.
**Setting up link and image insertion**

I'm working on a link insertion prompt and image insertion via URL. Full-screen functionality isn't necessary. I'll include an `onChange` that returns a sanitized HTML string along with a `value` prop, `onChange`, and `className`. I need to manage placeholder and focus states, converting to a controlled component. When the input changes, I’ll update `ref.current.innerHTML` if it differs and the editor isn’t focused. Pasting needs to handle plain text, and I'll implement DOMParser sanitization with an allowlist for tags and attributes, ensuring links have `rel="noreferrer noopener"`. Rather than sanitizing every keystroke, it might be better to do this on blur or save.
**Revising the rich text editor setup**

I’m exploring another approach for the editor: instead of rewriting on input, I could read the editor's `innerHTML` and call `onChange(html)` without sanitizing until save or preview. However, the preview uses state, and while it’s vulnerable, it should be safe if sanitized on render. I’ll implement a `sanitizeHtml` function within the same file as the editor for convenience and export it. About the CMS editor, I plan to replace the textarea for the body with `<RichTextEditor value={body} onChange={setBody} />`. As for the home template fields, I’m hesitant to convert them to rich text if they’re currently used as plain, so I might keep them that way to prevent extensive changes.</details></think>

---

Nice — the CMS already centralizes editing in `src/app/cms/pages/[id]/page.tsx`, and `page.body` is the main “longform” field (currently a plain `<textarea>`). Next I’ll implement the one-file rich text editor component and then swap this body textarea + the public rendering (`src/app/[slug]/page.tsx`, `src/app/page.tsx`, preview) to treat `body` as rich HTML safely.
